query: What are the requirements for BukSU-CAT?
response_preview: What to bring on the examination day Test takers must bring the following items: 1. Test Permit (can be downloaded from the BukSU
full_response:
What to bring on the examination day
Test takers must bring the following items:
1. Test Permit (can be downloaded from the BukSU admission website)
2. Application Form (can be downloaded from the BukSU admission website)
3. Pen
4. Pencil No. 2, eraser, and sharpener
Please be reminded that this is for Admission examination, not for college course examinations. For college course examinations, please refer to the specific requirements provided by your respective colleges.

query: Unsaon nako pag-apply sa BukSU kung Grade 12 pa ko?
response_preview: Ania ang mga kinahanglanon nga imong andamon sa dili pa mag-apply para sa BukSU Admission Testing: 1. Kinahanglan naa kay personal
full_response:
Ania ang mga kinahanglanon nga imong andamon sa dili pa mag-apply para sa BukSU Admission Testing:
1. Kinahanglan naa kay personal nga Gmail account aron makahimo og account sa BukSU Admissions: https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/
2. Kinahanglan pud ka og digital copy sa imong 2x2 nga litrato. Siguroa nga ang imong litrato mosunod sa mosunod nga specifications: puti nga background, nagsul-ob og puti nga T-shirt, walay accessories, ug sakto nga 2x2 nga size.
Para sa documentary requirements:
Report card, Transcript of Records, Principal’s Certification, GWA, ug Diploma. Optional ra kini basta naa kay Principal’s Certification. Siguroa nga pirmado kini sa imong principal ug sakto ang pag-seal.
Human ka mag-apply para sa BukSU Admission, palihog hulata ang approval.
Note: Siguroa nga ma-access nimo ang imong Gmail, kay didto ipadala ang tanang verification codes.

query: Do I need to take an entrance exam even if I'm a transferee?
response_preview: For transferees, you must first take and pass the BukSU Admission process before you can enroll. After passing admission, proceed
full_response:
For transferees, you must first take and pass the BukSU Admission process before you can enroll.
After passing admission, proceed to the college or department where you plan to enroll so your academic records can be evaluated.
Prepare transferee-related documents such as Honorable Dismissal, Transcript of Records or informative copy, Subject Equivalency Form if required, and the other enrollment documentary requirements listed for undergraduate first year/transferee applicants.
Once your documents are evaluated, follow the online enrollment application steps through https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph and wait for your department or evaluator instructions.
For private school transferees, expect possible delays because previously taken subjects may need additional evaluation and may not all be credited.

full_response:
Para sa BukSU-CAT qualification, ang non-board courses kasagaran nagkinahanglan og at least 50% CAT score.
Ang board courses kasagaran nagkinahanglan og 80% pataas nga CAT score.
Mahimo gihapon kini mausab depende sa opisyal nga admission guidelines sa current academic year, busa mas maayo nga i-confirm sa BukSU Admission and Testing Unit kung kinahanglan nimo ang final qualification details.

query: How do I enroll after passing the BukSU-CAT?

full_response:
Here is the step-by-step enrollment process for **Undergraduate Programs, Law & Graduate Programs, and College of Medicine**:
Step 1. You may look on the picture provided below for the requirements needed.
Step 2: Login to https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph
• Click on **Admission**
• Click **Show Exam Result** then proceed to enrollment
• Click **Apply Enrollment**
- **Campus Selection**: Select **Main Campus**
- **Course Selection**: Select your **Preferred Course**
- **Documentary Requirements**: Scan and upload the documentary requirements as specified in Step 1

query: What if I already stopped studying at BukSU years ago, can I come back?
response_preview: Here is the readmission and enrollment process for Returning Students (Balik-Aral): • **Important Policies**: - Students who were
full_response:
Here is the readmission and enrollment process for Returning Students (Balik-Aral):
• **Important Policies**:
- Students who were under the **old curriculum** must re-enter the course as a first-year student.
- If it has been **more than 5 years** since your last semester of attendance, university policy dictates that you must retake the BukSU College Admission Test (BukSU-CAT) and pay a ₱300 testing fee to be reintegrated.
• **Step-by-Step Readmission Procedure**:
1. Register online at: https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph
2. Activate your account via email (click the activation link).
3. Update your Account Information.
4. Click 'Proceed to Account Migration' and use your previous student number to migrate your account.
5. Apply for Enrollment.
6. Steps 1–5: Complete all required information.
7. Step 6: Verify, sign, and confirm your Enrollment Application.
8. Submit and wait for your Evaluator to process your Enrollment Application.
9. Retrieve and review your Certificate of Registration (COR).
For the complete official guide, visit: https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph/posts/12/

query: Ma'am unsay requirements sa transferee kay naa koy transcript na?
response_preview: Para sa transferees, kinahanglan una ka moagi ug mopasar sa BukSU Admission process bago ka maka-enroll. Human makapasar sa admiss
full_response:
Para sa transferees, kinahanglan una ka moagi ug mopasar sa BukSU Admission process bago ka maka-enroll.
Human makapasar sa admission, adto sa college o department kung asa ka gusto mo-enroll aron ma-evaluate ang imong academic records.
Pag-andam og transferee-related documents sama sa Honorable Dismissal, Transcript of Records o informative copy, Subject Equivalency Form kung required, ug uban pang enrollment documentary requirements para sa undergraduate first year/transferee applicants.
Kung ma-evaluate na ang documents, sundon ang online enrollment application steps sa https://admissions.buksu.edu.ph ug hulata ang instructions sa department o evaluator.
Para sa private school transferees, posible nga naay delay kay kinahanglan pa i-evaluate ang previous subjects ug dili tanan subject automatic ma-credit.
